decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom builds directly on the firm's decades of water phantom and dosimetry expertise, but its niche market, missing US clearance and weaker web presence in 2019 point to some risk of withdrawal.
Small volume ionization chambers are core dosimetry know-how that the firm can calibrate and refine in-house, so the product fits its absorptive capacity and has long life-cycle potential.
This small-field chamber draws on the firm's established chamber design and accredited calibration knowledge, and stayed consistently presented, so management would keep it.
A standard clinical ionization chamber line with several models is a central reference product for the firm's dosimetry portfolio and is easily supported by its existing competence.
Relative dosimetry chambers complement the firm's water phantoms and QA software, so it can interpret field feedback well and integrate the product into its platform.
Thimble chambers are a classic dosimetry product rooted in the firm's core knowledge and calibration services, which makes them low-risk to keep.
